title: Does it matter which set of numbers we read?
description: The angles T O Q and T O S are found on the inner set of numbers of the protractor with six rays, and the answer is checked by splitting T O Q into two smaller angles. Keeko's doubt, that the inner and outer sets give different angles, is broken by reading the same angle on the outer set.
teaching_notes: One idea: an angle can be named from either end, and either set of numbers gives its measure if both arms are read on the same set. Watch for children who read one arm on each set.

source: Did you include angles such as ∠TOQ? Which set of markings d
video_script.why: The child finds an angle named from the other end, and sees that the inner set and the outer set give the same angle.
video_script.substitution: The book's labelled protractor with the rays OP, OQ, OR, OS, OT and OU, read on the inner set first and on the outer set for the doubt.
video_script.anchor: the book's labelled protractor with six rays OP, OQ, OR, OS, OT and OU leaving the centre O
video_script.wrong_answer: the inner and outer scales give different angles
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko says the inner and outer scales give different angles, because the numbers on them are different. The numbers change but the gap between two rays does not, so the bubble is struck.
video_script.payoff_line: T O Q measures one hundred and twenty five degrees, the same as Q O T. T O S measures thirty five degrees, the same as S O T.

final_answer.value: ∠TOQ = 125° (same as ∠QOT); ∠TOS = 35° (same as ∠SOT); either set works if both arms are read from the same zero arm
final_answer.spoken: T O Q is one hundred and twenty five degrees, T O S is thirty five degrees, and either set works if both arms are read from the same zero arm

maths_rules: angle TOQ and angle QOT are the same angle
inner set, zero on OP: T at 160, Q at 35, S at 125
check: QOS = 125 - 35 = 90, and QOS + SOT = 90 + 35 = 125 = QOT
outer set, zero on OU: T at 20, S at 55, Q at 145; QOT = 145 - 20 = 125 and SOT = 55 - 20 = 35, the same angles
video_script.design: The protractor with six rays stays on the board. Readings on the inner set are used for the working, and the outer set is lit only for Keeko's doubt.
